notes.title: Summer Sale: Tokyo School Life Trading Cards & OST Are Here!
notes.content:
Tokyo School Life is all ready for the summer! The Summer Sale that is!
Feel like taking a little summer trip? Tokyo School Life has got you covered with this informative and memorable story of a summer trip to Japan. Don't miss this chance to play at a special low price!

To make things even better, we're celebrating the release of our Steam Trading Cards and Original Soundtrack! 

Deck out your profile with some all new artwork from our profile backgrounds, and earn some badges to show off too. Plus, don't forget to show support for your favorite character on the forums using the new emoticons!

The Tokyo School Life Original Soundtrack features nine tracks from TSL by Jaelyn Nisperos, plus a karaoke version of the opening song, and some bonus goodies! (...And if any of you want to take a shot at singing the opening song, we'd love to hear your take on it on the forums!)

Have a great summer, and thanks for playing!
